from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font

folder = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
csv_path = os.path.join(folder, "addresses.csv")

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Addresses"

with open(csv_path, newline="") as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    for row in reader:
        ws.append(row)

for cell in ws[1]:
    cell.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"

for col in ws.columns:
    width = max(len(str(c.value)) for c in col)
    ws.column_dimensions[col[0].column_letter].width = width + 2

out = os.path.join(folder, "addresses.xlsx")
wb.save(out)
print("Saved", out, "with", ws.max_row - 1, "data rows")
"}
